verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page claims you can 'Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks', which is a first-party claim of scheduled workflow automation. Nothing else in the pack documents how schedules are set up, how often they can repeat, or what kinds of jobs they can run. missing for 10: documentation of how schedules are configured, explicit confirmation of recurring cadence (cron or intervals), detail on which jobs or workflows can be scheduled, an API or agent-accessible way to manage schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
